Based on my investigation, the issue requests that items in the extra networks interfaces (checkpoints, hypernetworks, textual inversions) be sorted by date by default instead of by name. This way, when a user downloads a new model, it appears first and they can immediately use it.

The default sorting behavior is controlled by two settings in `modules/shared_options.py`:
- `extra_networks_card_order_field` — currently defaults to `"Name"`
- `extra_networks_card_order` — currently defaults to `"Ascending"`

To sort by date with newest first, I'll change the default field to `"Date Modified"` and the order to `"Descending"`.
